what: Panels stacked in one cell switch to the next every 10 seconds (outgoing .25s ease-out-quad, incoming .01s later with .25s ease-in-quad). With number buttons, a ring is drawn around the current button over 10 seconds with no curve (appearing in the first 5% and disappearing in the last 5%), and pressing a button or the prev/next arrow goes to that panel and restarts the 10 seconds from zero.

options.every: How long each panel stays (seconds), default 10
options.--fx-fade: Duration of the panel change (style), default .25s
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Panels to stack (children, two or more) — the current panel has is-on
options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Number buttons (optional) — the part puts a ring svg inside. aria-current on the current button
